sanskrit_verse:
भयदृष्टोद्भवा मिथ्या गर्हिता शास्त्रवेदिभिः ।
सत्या संप्रतिपत्तिस्तु धर्म्या सा परिकीर्तिता ॥
transliteration: bhayadṛṣṭodbhavā mithyā garhitā śāstravedibhiḥ | satyā saṃpratipattis tu dharmyā sā parikīrtitā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Falsehood arising from fear is condemned by those versed in scripture; truth known through direct realization is declared righteous.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from realized consciousness, not fear-conditioned perception
Causation originates in experiential cognition, not reactive emotion
Capacity-based responsibility arises from clarity of insight, not social pressure
Restoration occurs when cognition aligns with experiential truth
executable_legal_axioms: IF a statement originates from fear-induced distortion THEN it has no standing in Dharma-adjudication
IF a claimant demonstrates experientially grounded awareness THEN their testimony carries Dharma-weight
IF cognitive distortion is detected due to survival-reactivity THEN initiate restoration protocol before proceeding
IF witness integrity is compromised by fear-conditioning THEN defer judgment until capacity is restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, testimonies rooted in fear or reactive conditioning carry no weight. Only statements emerging from stabilized, experiential cognition qualify as legally valid. The threshold for responsibility lies in the capacity for direct knowing, not emotional response.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that only what is directly cognized constitutes valid evidence. Fear distorts pramāṇa and therefore invalidates claims. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential correction begins with restoring perceptual clarity. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of conscious stabilization achieved. This maintains non-punitivity by focusing on realignment rather than blame.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate fear-dissolution process to restore perceptual clarity
Engage Sat-Chit-Ananda resonance activation to stabilize cognition
Assign completion process to reverse fear-conditioned behavioral patterns
Deploy consciousness-reintegration matrix to ensure alignment with experiential truth
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Fear-born falsehood holds no jurisdiction in Dharma. Truth realized through awakened cognition alone governs justice. All beings are restored to integrity through consciousness realignment. There is no punishment—only awakening.
